mathematics.base: b(x)=frozen GRID107 two-action Q prediction for this seed.
mathematics.original_target: y=[0, immediate normalized net continuation] from original GRID107/113.
mathematics.correction_reference: r(x)=y-b(x), detached; no new outcome label or changed reward.
mathematics.output: q(x,z)=b(x)+delta(x,z); CONTINUE iff q[1]>q[0], tie STOP.
mathematics.optimization: Keep original smooth_l1(q,y,beta=1,mean) in prospective trainer. In exact arithmetic this equals smooth_l1(delta,y-b,beta=1,mean).
mathematics.identifiability: Base cannot absorb an arbitrary opposite shift while frozen. This fixes the output reference, not the internal neural representation or causal meaning of features.

initialization.base: Exact original trained GRID107 final weights, not random and not selected from GRID116.
initialization.correction: Original GRID1135938 architecture; seed=20261023+s, JOINT/FACTOR identical tensors; last16->2 layer zero.
initialization.optimizer: All prospective extra-stage optimizers start fresh; never import SB3 Adam moments. BASE_EXTRA is reset-optimizer additional training, not uninterrupted continuation.
initialization.gradient: Frozen base excluded by parameter identity; first correction head update inside7250, upstream gradients initially zero. Check flow after first actual step, no warmup fitting.

unchanged.normalization: Original frozen41; full public geometry/paid feedback schema fromGRID112/113 without truncation.
unchanged.optimizer: Adam lr0.0003 betas0.9/0.999 eps1e-8 weight_decay0; clip_grad_norm10.
unchanged.loss: Original smooth_l1 beta1 mean over32x2. No auxiliary/classification/contrastive loss, class weighting or fee/threshold change.
unchanged.target: Original immediate normalized net continuation, STOP0.
unchanged.sampling: Per seed, reproduce original 7250x32 stream then use its next7250x32 draws for all three new arms; same probabilities, no class reweighting.
unchanged.train_mode: Stage2 from each original GRID107 final base checkpoint. Fixed base for JOINT/FACTOR; BASE_EXTRA updates only original backbone. Fresh Adam for all new arms.

future_fits.endpoint: Fixed final only; evaluate validation only after all9 fits. Keep every seed and partial failure; no automatic extension or refit.

comparisons.primary: FIXED_JOINT vs FIXED_FACTOR: same base, architecture, trainable count, initialization, optimizer, inputs and sampling; feedback association differs.
comparisons.practical: Each corrected family vs BASE_FIXED: incremental addition, includes extra7250 training.
comparisons.additional_training: Each corrected family vs BASE_EXTRA: equal original pretraining and extra update/target exposure; not equal architecture, trainable count, FLOPs or wall time.
comparisons.historical: GRID116 and other historical offline outcomes stay visible; no claim that changing freezing alone is identified, because the new proposal also introduces staged pretraining.

evaluation.primary: Complete saved local-search validation trajectory four-date macro normalized net utility, all seeds.
evaluation.mechanism_signal: JOINT family mean>FACTOR, all3paired seed differences>0,>=3/4 date differences>0 after seed averaging; report actual magnitudes and all adverse results.
evaluation.incremental: Report all paired seeds against BASE_FIXED and BASE_EXTRA, not only mean; preserve BATCH1 and original gamma0 DQN references.
evaluation.progression: Mechanism signal as before AND JOINT family mean above BASE_FIXED, BASE_EXTRA, BATCH1 and original gamma0DQN; no automatic scaling or physical replay.
evaluation.diagnostics: Three preexposed108/552/RF-path552 always shown. Same fixed label-independent cyclic-pair sensitivity used after fits only; not an acceptance criterion or deployed policy.
evaluation.interpretation: Four exposed dates, correlated prefixes, same grid, FULL teacher-path immediate value. No whole-week quality, statistical significance, latency or cross-grid claim.

limitations: Correction can still worsen decisions or ignore action-feedback pairing; freezing does not guarantee improvement.
